data.name: Audrina
data.gender_notes: Audrina is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Audrina is derived from the Old German word 'audr' meaning noble and 'rinn' meaning warrior or strength. The name suggests a noble and strong personality, someone who is brave and wise in the face of challenges. The name Audrina carries the meaning “Noble warrior, strong in battle” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Audrina usually hope their child will grow to embody noble warrior, strong in battle and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Audrina is a name that evokes a sense of inner strength and courage. It is a name that resonates with the spirit of the warrior, someone who is not afraid to face adversity and emerge victorious.
data.etymology: Audrina belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Noble warrior, strong in battle.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Audrina total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_greek.name: Αυδρίνα

Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, η έννοια της ακρόασης και της υπακοής στον λόγο του Θεού είναι κεντρική. Το όνομα Αυδρίνα αντανακλά την πνευματική διάσταση της ακρόασης και της απόκρισης στο μήνυμα του Θεού.
